latestSnapshot.readme:
Languge Task Battery (LTB) dataset:
-fMRI data for 17 subjects, 8 of which had resting state data as well.

Task data:
-16 tasks (including rest), some of which contained multiple conditions, yielding a total of 18 task conditions. All tasks presented in each run, total of 8 imaging runs (~ 10 minutes per run).

Resting state data:
-7 imaging runs ~ 10 minutes each.
- Only available for: sub-01, sub-02, -sub-03, sub-04, sub-06, sub-07, sub-12, sub-19

Please cite the following reference if you use these data:
 Arafat, B., Nettekoven, C., Xiang, J. D., & Diedrichsen, J. (2026). Multi-Task Batteries for Precision Functional Mapping. bioRxiv, 2026-03.
